If you are using the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you are authorized to bind that organization to these Terms.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookies Policy explains how makombe uses cookies and similar technologies when you use our Service, and the choices available to you.

sections.heading: What are cookies
body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work, improve functionality, and provide information to site operators.
Similar technologies, such as local storage, may be used for comparable purposes.

sections.heading: Types of cookies we use
body: Strictly necessary: required for the Service to function, such as routing and security.
Preferences: remember choices you make, including your selected language and theme (light or dark).
Analytics: help us understand how the Service is used so we can improve it. These are only used where permitted.

sections.heading: How to control cookies
body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking some cookies may affect how the Service functions.
Where required, we request your consent before setting non-essential cookies.

sections.heading: Third-party cookies
body: Some cookies may be set by third parties that provide services on our behalf, such as analytics providers. Their use of cookies is governed by their own policies.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date indicates when it was last revised.

cookies.contact: If you have questions about our use of cookies, contact us at legal@makombe.app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how makombe collects, uses, and protects information in connection with the Service, and the rights you have regarding your information.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: Information you provide directly, such as when you contact us or configure preferences.
Information collected automatically, such as usage data, device and browser information, and cookie identifiers.
Preference information, including your chosen language and theme.

sections.heading: How we use information
body: To provide, maintain, and improve the Service.
To remember your preferences and personalize your experience.
To analyze usage, ensure security, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: Legal bases for processing
body: Where applicable law requires it, we process personal information on the basis of your consent, our legitimate interests, the performance of a contract, or compliance with a legal obligation.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use cookies and similar technologies as described in our Cookies Policy. Please review it for details on the cookies we use and how to control them.

sections.heading: How we share information
body: We do not sell your personal information.
We may share information with service providers who process it on our behalf, and where required by law or to protect our rights.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We retain information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

sections.heading: Security
body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal information, and to object to certain processing.
To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
body: The Service is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

sections.heading: International transfers
body: Your information may be processed in countries other than the one in which you reside. Where required, we take steps to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date indicates when it was last revised.

privacy.contact: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us at legal@makombe.app.
